trace.question: What is the fastest lap number of the champion in 2009?
trace.evidence: in 2009 refers to year = 2009; Only the time of the champion shows in the format of "hour: minutes: seconds.millionsecond"

attempts.sql:
SELECT r.fastestLap
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId AND ds.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2009)
  AND ds.position = 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT r.fastestLap
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId AND ds.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2009)
  AND ds.position = 1
trace.answer: The fastest lap number recorded for the 2009 champion was lap 49.
